description: List sales orders (weclapp "salesOrder"), newest order date first, in a short form: order number, the customer's own order number, customer, status, order and planned delivery date, amounts, shipped/invoiced/paid. Narrow with customer_id, order_number (weclapp's number), customer_order_number (the number on the customer's purchase order / mail) or status (ORDER_ENTRY_IN_PROGRESS, ORDER_CONFIRMATION_PRINTED, CLOSED, MANUALLY_CLOSED, CANCELLED). `filters` wird als Abfrageparameter durchgereicht — weclapp filtert nach dem Muster feld-eq, feld-like, feld-gt (z. B. { "name-like": "%Muster%" }). raw: true returns the full records. Read-only.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

raw.description: true = return the full weclapp records

name: list_weclapp_sales_orders
